newsitem.title: CHINA: CCT Tel soars after joint venture deal.
newsitem.headline: CCT Tel soars after joint venture deal.

text.p: Shares of CCT Telecom Holdings Ltd surged on hopes of stronger earnings after the company said it would form a joint venture with a firm partly-owned by China's Ministry of Electronics Industry, brokers said.
CCT Telecom shares, the second most actively traded stock by turnover, surged HK$0.45 or 33 percent to HK$1.80 in late morning after they hit a year high of HK$1.87.
Volume was 488.22 million shares worth HK$817.17 million.
"Hopes of possible asset injections and benefits from stronger business ties with Chinese authorities boosted short term buying," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
"However it is hard to say how far it will go or where it will consolidate in the red-chip fenzy," said a research manager at a local brokerage.

CCT Telecom said earlier it had agreed to form a 67 percent owned joint venture with a firm partly owned by the Ministry of Electronics Industry, to produce and distribute telecommunicartions equipment and networks.
Trading in CCT Telecom shares was suspended on Monday and was resumed on Thursday.
